title: Lincoln Theatre

services.name: Video Rentals
services.desc: The Lincoln Theatre purchases DVDs and Blu-rays of all of the films we've screened here (and some we wish we had). Over the years we have collected nearly 3000 titles. Videos will be issued on a first-come first-served basis. Choose from over 2500 titles in our Video Library! Click HERE for the full list. Click HERE to see just our most recent additions since COVID (over 700 titles). We will confirm availability when we receive your order. At $2 each, our new releases are less than Amazon and in our library months before Netflix. You can keep your videos for a week and return them any time through the video drop in our Box Office

services.name: Ticket
services.desc: The Lincoln Theatre offers a number of easy ways to purchase a ticket for either films or our live events! All Lincoln Theatre events with tickets currently on sale are listed on our home page. You may filter the list by viewing Live Events Only or Films Only. You will have the option of printing your ticket at home, or picking up your tickets at the theatre during Box Office hours or before the event. You may also simply show us your ticket confirmation on your smart phone or similar electronic device at the event. If you're in downtown Mount Vernon, stop by the Lincoln Theatre Ticket Office at 313 West Kincaid Street (Directions). We're open Monday - Friday from noon to 5:00
